summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of all major requirements (JUnit/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown generation, and end-to-end workflow via act). Good edge case handling (malformed input, stable vs. flaky failures, multiple result statuses). Well-organized into fast Structure tests and slow Act tests with excellent fixture isolation via TestDrive and temp git repos. Self-documenting inline fixture data. Main gaps: no testing of CLI flags (-FailOnTestFailure, -OutputPath, -SummaryPath), no explicit assertion that act-result.txt is populated correctly, limited matrix cases (only 2 act runs), and no direct parsing/verification of machine-readable output format (AGG_TOTALS lines). Would catch most regressions but misses some CLI parameter and GitHub-specific integration edge cases.
